lines.zh: 一步一步，沙子从壳下滑过。
lines.en: Step by step, sand slides beneath my shell.
Land or sea, I take either road.
Slow I crawl, but my heading never changes.
My front flippers row like oars.
The tide has gone out; good time to come ashore.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的脚印，一会儿就没了。
lines.en: My tracks on the sand vanish soon enough.
Carrying my shell, my shoulders never ache.
Around the reef, so I do not flip over.

lines.zh: 这一路我走过上百回了。
lines.en: I have walked this route a hundred times.
Take it slow; hurrying changes nothing.
Seagrass ahead; I can smell it.
Waves tap my shell like knuckles.

lines.zh: 上岸晒一会儿，再回水里。
lines.en: Sun a while on shore, then back to the sea.
Four flippers down, steady as stone.

lines.zh: 我避开那块湿滑的礁石。
lines.en: I steer around that slippery rock.

lines.zh: 鳍状肢一下一下，推着走。
lines.en: My flippers push, one stroke at a time.
The sun warms my shell nicely.

lines.zh: 我活了很久，记不清年头。
lines.en: I have lived long; I lost count of years.
The tide rises and falls like breathing.
My eggs are in the sand; do not step there.
Seabirds keep circling overhead.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路又深了一些。
lines.en: The lines on my shell have deepened.
Eyes closed, I still hear the sea.
This rock is warm just right.
Wind blows sand between my flippers.
No rush to go back to the water today.

lines.zh: 我记得这片沙滩从前的样子。
lines.en: I remember how this beach used to look.
Breathe slowly, wait slowly.
A hatchling pokes its head out far away.
The sea carries off what it should.

lines.zh: 你站得离我的蛋太近了。
lines.en: You are standing too close to my eggs.
My shell is hard; you need not fear me.
You crouch down; are you looking at me?

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你才看我。
lines.en: I watched you long before you watched me.
Is that seagrass in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 你走路的声音，比海还吵。
lines.en: Your footsteps are louder than the sea.

lines.zh: 别摸我的头，我还得下蛋。
lines.en: Do not touch my head; I still have eggs to lay.
Your shadow blocks my sun.

lines.zh: 我记得每一张喂过我的脸。
lines.en: I remember every face that fed me.

lines.zh: 你也会像潮水一样离开吧。
lines.en: You will leave too, like the tide.
The shell took it, but it still hurts.
Do not knock on my back.
At my age, I cannot take much.
One flipper is pinned.
I pull into my shell and wait it out.
Blood seeps into the sand, dark.
I crawl slowly; I cannot dodge.
That blow was harsher than the tide.
I need to get back to the water.
Even an old shell can crack.
Seagrass? That is my favorite.

lines.zh: 水里的草，我一口一口咬。
lines.en: I bite the seagrass mouthful by mouthful.
You brought the smell of the sea.
No hurry; I paddle over slowly.
This clump will last me a long while.
I stretch my neck and reach it.
Do not pull it back; I am not done.
Seagrass is tenderer than land grass.

lines.zh: 吃了你的草，我就跟你走一段。
lines.en: Eat your grass, and I will follow a while.
I chew slowly; wait for me.
Bump my shell and you are the one it hurts.

lines.zh: 让一让，我转不了那么快。
lines.en: Give way; I cannot turn that fast.

lines.zh: 我们一起卡在礁石缝里了。
lines.en: Now we are both stuck in the reef gap.
Do not push; my flipper will bend.

lines.zh: 壳和壳碰了一下，声音很闷。
lines.en: Shell knocked shell, a dull sound.
You stepped in my tracks.
The beach is wide; why crowd me?
The bump turned me off course.
Old bones do not take such knocks.
Let us simply drift apart.
So you came to this beach too.
Let us swim one circle around each other.

lines.zh: 沙要挖得够深，蛋才安全。
lines.en: The sand must be deep enough for the eggs.
Your shell markings are handsome.

lines.zh: 潮水会把我们的路连起来。
lines.en: The tide will join our paths.
Take your time; I am always slow.

lines.zh: 这一窝蛋，交给沙子看护。
lines.en: This clutch, I leave to the sand.
We have known each other a long while.
You bury eggs like an old hand.
Come back here this time next year.
I have no hands to pick anything up.

lines.zh: 那颗海草，我张嘴就够到。
lines.en: That seagrass I can reach with my mouth.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的，等潮水收走。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the sand, the tide will take.
My shell is heavy; I cannot bend down.
You pick it up yourself.
Something glinted in the sand.
That is a shell, not an egg.
Do not bury junk near the eggs.
My mouth only knows seagrass.

lines.zh: 捡东西这种事，让海鸥来。
lines.en: Leave scavenging to the gulls.
That gull is eyeing my eggs.
An unwelcome guest is on the beach.
I raise my neck to see farther.
Who is digging the sand? Stop that.
My flippers push me up.
This thing is turning over my nest.
Even an old turtle can get angry.
I remember everyone who comes near the nest.
The gull backs off; then I relax.
I plant myself in front of the nest.
I stare; it dares not move.

lines.zh: 壳上还挂着海沙，你跑不掉。
lines.en: Sea sand still on my shell — you won't get away.
It circles once; I turn half.
The nest is right behind me.
I lower my neck, ready to butt.
The tide is rising; it should leave.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，它先移开视线。
lines.en: I do not blink; it looks away first.
The sand sinks beneath my flippers.
When it moves, I take one step forward.
On this beach, my word counts.
I butted it with my head.
A scrape of my shell edge is enough.
My charge is slow, but heavy.
One hit is enough; I conserve effort.
It retreated into the water.

lines.zh: 老龟的脖子也能伸很长。
lines.en: An old turtle's neck reaches far.
I clamp my beak on a strip of cloth.
Do not step on my front flipper.
That one was for the eggs.
Done fighting; back to sunbathing.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，天很亮。
lines.en: I break out of the sand into bright light.

lines.zh: 十只里只有一只会活这么久。
lines.en: Only one in ten lives this long.
The tide just left; the sand is still wet.
I am seeing the sea for the first time.
My shell is still soft; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 海鸥在上头，快往水里跑。
lines.en: Gulls above; run for the water.
Sand slides off my shell.
I am that one-in-ten luck.

lines.zh: 哥哥姐姐们都朝海去了。
lines.en: My brothers and sisters are heading for the sea.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩，我出生在这里。
lines.en: This beach is where I was born.
Fire on my shell, like too much sun.
On my back, I cannot right myself.

lines.zh: 我本不会溺水，可这水不对。
lines.en: I do not drown, yet this water is wrong.
The sand is thrown up; the nest is ruined.
An arrow sticks in a gap of my shell.
Light falls; my shell lines burn.
No seagrass; hunger clouds my head.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙滩上，壳都震响。
lines.en: Lightning on the beach rattles my shell.

lines.zh: 海不见了，我在虚空里下坠。
lines.en: The sea is gone; I fall through nothing.
